edits.headline: Almost 1,000 arrested after another day of mass protests in France
edits.subheadline: More than 400,000 people protested across France and some clashes broke out at the end of the marches, AFP reported.
editorialBody: Almost 1,000 people were arrested as clashes followed another day of mass protests across France, BBC News reported. More than 400,000 people protested across the country, AFP reported, and some clashes broke out at the end of the marches.
France's far right gathered as Marine Le Pen prepares her presidential campaign, AFP reported.
Brazil voted in a tight presidential runoff between Lula, who is on the left, and the right-wing Flavio Bolsonaro, DW News reported.

A Russian ambassador said Russia was sharing agricultural technologies with African partners, Sputnik reported. Sputnik also reported that the Russian army was advancing across front lines in Ukraine.
In New York, a female police officer says in a lawsuit that a captain and a group of officers tormented her after she rejected his advances, the New York Post reported.

Indian and Australian troops are training for coastal and island warfare in the AUSTRAHIND 2026 exercise, the Times of India reported. India's Congress party questioned the Election Commission over withholding ECINET details, the paper said.
